npc.salvage_specialist.flavor_text: I've stripped more claims than the Guild keeps records of. If the escrow ore is real, I want first look at it.
npc.depot_attendant.flavor_text: Everything that lands here is somebody's problem eventually. The bonded rows are my problem today.
step.mer_q1_contract.title: The Contract
step.mer_q1_contract.description: Sign the Guild's contract on Earth. The Guild gets first claim on anything recovered from the Mars site; you get the cutter that opens it. The first clause points at an old Wolf 359 claim.
step.mer_q1_contract.dialogue.guild_mast: The contract is short because long ones make people read them. The Guild gets first claim on the Mars site; you get the cutter that opens it. First clause: the Wolf 359 escrow ore that pays for the work. Sign, and I file the deed today.
step.mer_q1_contract.completion_flavor: The deed is filed and the claim is yours on paper. Clearance takes some weeks - the Guild's lawyers are thorough when the ore is worth it. They will call when the way to Wolf 359 b is clear.
step.mer_q1_contract.ready_message: The claim is cleared. Reach Wolf 359 b and recover the escrow ore from the caves beneath the listening post. The consortium knows the deed changed hands; expect them to contest it.
step.mer_q2_strike.title: The Claim
step.mer_q2_strike.description: Descend into the Wolf 359 b caves and work the Guild's abandoned claim. Consortium prospectors are already in the deep cache - clear them out and secure the escrow ore.
step.mer_q2_strike.dialogue.guild_master: The claim sat dormant long enough for everyone to forget who paid for it. The ore is in the deep cache - unless the consortium has decided a neglected deed is an invitation.
step.mer_q2_strike.completion_flavor: The raw ore is loaded into your hold - valuable, disputed, and useless until it is smelted. The Guild's only specialist for material this pure works out of Tau Ceti b, and the consortium has noticed whose hold it is in.
step.mer_q3_transport.title: The Smelt
step.mer_q3_transport.description: The ore is in your mission hold, unrefined and already hunted. Run it to the Guild's salvage specialist at Tau Ceti b. To the consortium, this cargo is not freight - it is their claim walking away.
step.mer_q3_transport.dialogue.salvage_s: So the escrow ore is real. Hand it over and I will fire up the smelter - assuming it agrees to run. Material this pure has opinions.
Smelter's running hot. The readings keep jumping. Give it time.
step.mer_q3_transport.completion_flavor: The specialist feeds the ore in and goes quiet. The assay comes back impossible: stronger than anything in the Guild's catalogue, with traces that match no human mine. 'Give me time,' is all he says.
step.mer_q3_transport.ready_message: The smelt is done. The alloy is harder than any steel in the shop and it holds its edge. Collect it at Tau Ceti b. The Guild has also found a rig for the cutter - the bond on it is settled at the Refueling Depot in Epsilon Eridani.
step.mer_q4_bribe.title: The Bond
step.mer_q4_bribe.description: The Guild has found a cutting rig worthy of the alloy: the consortium's own bore, seized when your deed won Wolf 359. It sits in the bonded rows of the Refueling Depot, the station in Epsilon Eridani, while consortium lawyers contest the seizure. The station will release it against a posted bond - 8,000cr that stands in for the consortium's claim if their suit wins. Raise it however you like, then pay the depot attendant inside the station's bonded warehouse.
step.mer_q4_bribe.dialogue.depot_attenda: The consortium bore, row nine, still under contest. I can't sell it and I can't release it on my own signature - their lawyers would have this station. The charter leaves one door: release against a posted bond. Cash that stands in for the consortium's claim if their side wins later. The bond on that bore is 8,000cr. Post it and row nine is yours to winch out - your money, your risk, my name clean. However you come by the credits is between you and your ledger.
step.mer_q4_bribe.completion_flavor: The bond is posted, row nine opens, and the bore is winched onto the Guild's dock. If the consortium's suit lands later, the station keeps your 8,000cr and nobody comes after the attendant. The refit takes weeks - the mount must be bored and tempered to hold alloy teeth instead of consortium steel.
step.mer_q4_bribe.ready_message: The rig is refitted and waiting. The specialist has the smelted alloy at Tau Ceti b - collect it, then make for Vega.
step.mer_q5_alloy.title: The Alloy
step.mer_q5_alloy.description: Collect the smelted alloy from the salvage specialist at Tau Ceti b.
step.mer_q5_alloy.dialogue.salvage_speci: There is the alloy, loaded and lashed. Worth more than the ore, the claim, and my smelter. It is not enough on its own - the cutter has to cut in the right place. Before the Incident, a survey scout ran a structural scan of the Mars site: where the door carries strain, where a point force bites. The consortium attacked the scout to get that scan first. The wreck drifts near Vega. Get on board, find the recorder, and get out before they strip it. Bring it back and the smiths will know exactly where to set the teeth.
step.mer_q5_alloy.completion_flavor: The alloy is lashed in your hold. The specialist marks the wreck's drift near Vega.
step.mer_q6_survey.title: The Survey
step.mer_q6_survey.description: A survey scout ran a structural scan of the Mars site before the Incident. The consortium attacked it to claim the scan first. Board the wreck near Vega, find the recorder, and bring it back before they strip it. The smiths need the scan to know where the cutter bites.
step.mer_q6_survey.active_description: Board the derelict scout near Vega, find the survey recorder, and bring it back before the consortium strips the wreck.
step.mer_q6_survey.completion_flavor: The recorder is recovered and the consortium leader is not a problem you will hear about again. The survey does not explain the door - it shows where it fails. The Guild's smiths will want time to set the teeth to the weak lines and true the drive to the load.
step.mer_q6_survey.ready_message: The smiths are done. The teeth are set to the survey's weak lines and the drive is trued. The cutter waits at the Guild on Earth.
step.mer_q7_cutter.title: The Cutter
step.mer_q7_cutter.description: Return to the Guild Master on Earth. The bore is refitted, the teeth are set to the survey's weak lines. The cutter is ready to be collected - and the door on Mars is ready to be opened.
step.mer_q7_cutter.dialogue.guild_master: There it is. Consortium steel, Guild refit, Wolf 359 teeth. The survey gave us the weak lines and the smiths cut the teeth to match. We are not asking the door anything - we are taking it apart where it was always going to come apart. Collect your cutter. The Guild keeps its end.
